purpose: Cloudflare hosts the official Confirm UI frontend without redefining its Stage 1/2 schema or authoring Harness receipts.

frontend_api.purpose: Return current wizard/session state. Stage 1 completion is followed by polling this endpoint until recommendation_stage_number >= 2.
Return the official finite option universe. The hosted adapter must use the pinned Harness catalog response/snapshot, not a Studio-owned catalog.
Return the official icon preview payload used by the icon chooser.
Return the official generated-image rendering comparison manifest.
Return the active official recommendation payload. Stage 1 includes browser-ready template_options; Stage 2 returns the final-plan recommendation. Must be no-store.

Capture the exact payload emitted by the official frontend. Cloudflare may mark it captured-not-validated, but must not manufacture local result.json/template_selection.json/template_handoff.json or claim Harness acceptance.
Hosted semantic: mark the remote UI session complete/closed. Never terminate the Cloudflare Worker.

session_routing.strategy: When /s/<token> is served, bind the browser to that Durable Object session using a secure host session mechanism. The unmodified official frontend may continue to issue absolute /api/* requests.
do_not: Do not rewrite or fork official app.js merely to add the session token to each fetch.
Do not expose the bearer token to unrelated sessions.
Do not let /api/confirm claim accepted/validated status.

stage_semantics.stage1: Official frontend submits communication contract + template_selection together, then enters waiting state and polls /api/session for Stage 2 readiness.
stage_semantics.between_stages: The pinned local Harness remains responsible for validating/canonicalizing the Stage 1 decision, applying/freezing template state, completing template handoff/equivalent chat state, and authoring recommendations.stage2.json.
stage_semantics.stage2: Official frontend confirms final plan/production and then calls /api/shutdown. Hosted capture is still not Harness acceptance.
stage_semantics.hosted_constraint: A remote page cannot itself execute the local Harness. When host execution is required between stages, preserve the same logical session and use an explicit browser/chat handoff; never fake the missing Harness step inside Cloudflare.

cache_policy: All /api/* responses and user/session state are Cache-Control: no-store.
authority_policy: Only the pinned local PPT Master Harness validates and continues the workflow. Cloudflare is a presentation/session transport adapter.
